description: A team whose days of rest (its previous game's kickoff to this game's kickoff, from games start_date) is <= 6.0 while its opponent's is >= 7.0. One treated row per team-game, side in {home,away}. Games where BOTH teams are on short rest are EXCLUDED (no differential).
source_measurement: UNDERPOWERED 2026-08-28 (event; effect nan, p=nan, n=16, BH crit 0.05; n-gate FAIL: 16 treated < 40). Pre-registered in data/factor_prereg_2026-08-28.json; BH q<0.05 across exactly the 5 registered hypotheses. display_only — promotion is a separate reviewed decision. || UNDERPOWERED, which is not the same as absent: 16 treated team-games against a 40-pair gate. A true short week (<=6 days rest while the opponent has >=7) is rare in weeks 4-15 of the CFB calendar, which is the only window the walk-forward backtest covers. This is a statement about the sample, not about football — the hypothesis is neither supported nor refuted.

description: home days of rest minus away days of rest, uncapped and untransformed.
source_measurement: REJECT 2026-08-28 (continuous; effect 0.2474, p=0.031764, n=2377, BH crit 0.03). Pre-registered in data/factor_prereg_2026-08-28.json; BH q<0.05 across exactly the 5 registered hypotheses. display_only — promotion is a separate reviewed decision. || REJECTED at the registered threshold (p=0.031764 vs BH crit 0.0300 at m=5). It WOULD have passed against a denominator of the 4 hypotheses that produced a p-value (crit 0.0375); the first execution of this script had exactly that bug and it was corrected before anything was recorded. A borderline result that survives only under a looser denominator is not a finding.

Pre-registered in data/factor_prereg_2026-08-28.json; BH q<0.05 across exactly the 5 registered hypotheses. display_only — promotion is a separate reviewed decision. || REJECTED cleanly and with power: p=0.515 on 835 matched pairs, effect +0.54 pts. description: home percent_ppa minus away percent_ppa from returning_{season}.parquet — the share of prior-season PPA back on the roster. Constant within a season by construction.
source_measurement: PASS 2026-08-28 (continuous; effect -3.8335, p=2.8328e-05, n=2328, BH crit 0.01). Pre-registered in data/factor_prereg_2026-08-28.json; BH q<0.05 across exactly the 5 registered hypotheses. display_only — promotion is a separate reviewed decision. || CAVEAT THAT CHANGES THE READING, recorded after the run: the registration failed to declare that this variable is ENDOGENOUS to the prediction it is scored against. `ratings.solve` uses `preseason_prior` as the ridge PRIOR MEAN, and that prior is built from talent + returning production with prior_w_returning=1.0, so returning production is already inside pred_b at every week. The slope is also WRONG-SIGNED against the registered direction (-3.83 vs hypothesised positive). The parsimonious reading is therefore NOT 'returning production predicts residuals' but 'the preseason prior over-weights returning production and the residual corrects it' — a model-calibration finding, not an external signal. Stays display_only. Re-fitting prior_w_returning is a separate exercise needing its own pre-registration and a walk-forward search; never a guessed constant (AGENT_BUILD_PROMPT section 8).

description: Walk-forward net punt-driven field position. For each team, over strictly-earlier weeks of the same season: mean start_yards_to_goal on that team's drives whose immediately preceding drive in the same game ended in a PUNT by the opponent, minus the mean start_yards_to_goal the opponents received on drives following that team's own PUNTs. Home value minus away value. Garbage-time drives and drives after period 4 are dropped, matching the gate-3 convention.
source_measurement: PASS 2026-08-28 (continuous; effect -0.1212, p=0.0011056, n=2377, BH crit 0.02). Pre-registered in data/factor_prereg_2026-08-28.json; BH q<0.05 across exactly the 5 registered hypotheses. display_only — promotion is a separate reviewed decision. || SIGN READS AS INTENDED once the module ERRATUM is applied: the registered differential is (field position received after their punt) minus (conceded after ours), and start_yards_to_goal is distance to the opponent's goal, so BETTER special teams is a more NEGATIVE differential. A negative slope therefore means better net punt play RAISES the residual — the substantive direction hypothesised. Magnitude 0.12 pts per yard of net punt field position, so a fraction of a point at realistic differentials. OVERLAP DECLARED IN ADVANCE: correlated with the registered field_position_diff (slope +0.6165, passed 2026-07-30), which mixes offence-earned and special-teams-earned field position. Not independent evidence; must not be counted twice.
